shortdesc.ph: Reasons for client role change failure.
The reason for a user role switch failure.

plentry.pd: (1): The number of broadcasters in the channel exceeds the limit. This enumeration value is reported only when the 128-user feature is enabled. The maximum number of broadcasters depends on the actual number of broadcasters configured when the 128-user feature is enabled.
(2): The request was rejected by the Agora server. It is recommended to prompt the user to retry switching roles.
(3): Request timed out. It is recommended to prompt the user to check the network connection and retry switching roles.
(4): The client instance is disconnected from the Agora edge server. You can troubleshoot the failure reason via the reason in the callback.

pd.p: 1: The number of hosts in the channel exceeds the limit.
pd.note: This enumerator is reported only when the support for 128 users is enabled. The maximum number of hosts is based on the actual number of hosts configured when you enable the 128-user feature.

pd.p: 2: The request is rejected by the Agora server. Agora recommends you prompt the user to try to switch their user role again.
3: The request is timed out. Agora recommends you prompt the user to check the network connection and try to switch their user role again.

dlentry.dd: This enumerator is deprecated since v4.4.0 and is not recommended for use.

pd.p: 4: The SDK is disconnected from the Agora edge server. You can troubleshoot the failure through the reason reported by .
